title: The Beginning After the End
altTitles: The Beginning After the End: Comic
description: King Grey has unrivaled strength, wealth, and prestige in a world governed by martial ability, but beneath his powerful exterior lies a man devoid of purpose. Reincarnated into a new world filled with magic and monsters as Arthur Leywin, he receives a second chance at life. As Arthur grows and discovers the mysteries of his new world, he must confront dangers that threaten everything he has come to cherish.
author: TurtleMe
